Zing Supported (ZS): Whether zing is supported.
Ring Supported (RS): Whether ring is supported.
Zing Enabled (ZE): Whether zing is enabled.
Ring Enabled (RE): Whether ring is enabled.
Qux Type (QT): The type of the qux. Refer to Figure 95.
Qux Kind (QK): This field is qux type specific (refer to Figure 95). The kinds are those of Figure 96.
Ding Qux: A qux that dings.
Ring Qux: A qux that rings.
Plain: A qux of no kind.
Fancy: A qux of a kind.
Qux Format 0 Support (QF0): The first format. The Qux Format is defined in Figure 98, and listed by Figure 97.
Qux Format 1 Support (QF1): The second format. The Qux Format is defined in Figure 98.
Qux Format 7 Support (QF7): The last format. The Qux Format is defined in Figure 98.
Qux Vector 0 (QV0): This field contains a Qux Vector.
Qux Vector 1 (QV1): This field contains a Qux Vector.
Qux Vector 3 (QV3): This field contains a Qux Vector.
